Fill from the provider's current price list; null means unknown and the report shows cost as not set. A run that calls models in two currencies shows no total (ops.summarize). Self-hosted models (gemma) have no per-token price: null until the team agrees on one. Keys may be glob patterns (case-insensitive, e.g. *qwen*); an exact name wins. Every currency is converted to fx.base with fx rates (T3-50); a currency without a rate gives no total.
